notes: «عن رؤيا النبي» names the subject of Ibn Umar's report, not a link; the Prophet is not a link; «وفي الباب عن أبي هريرة» and the grading remark are left out.

fixes.reason: RWY reads the dream subject «رؤيا» as a transmitter; the text gives it as the subject of Ibn Umar's report, not a link.

evidence.quote: عن عبد الله بن عمر، عن رؤيا النبي
